raw:
I treated the 100 measurements as noisy evidence, because a few single-edit swings of 30–78 points look like run noise. So I weighted them alongside structural reasoning about the cell. Two things drive these picks. First, connectivity: an edit matters most when it creates or removes the only path to the output. Second, conv value: swapping a parameter-free op for nor_conv_3x3 usually helps, and losing nor_conv_3x3 usually hurts.

These are judgments from those two sources, not statistically confirmed results. Hypotheses 1, 3, 4, 5 and 8 have some support in the data. Hypotheses 9 and 10 are untested here, because no experiment edited from an avg_pool_3x3 parent on those edges. Hypotheses 2 and 7 conflict with some measurements (experiments 32–33 and 66–68) and rest mainly on the disconnection argument.
